---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a crash, UI glitch, adblock issue, or regression in Ember
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: bug
---

## Description
A clear description of what went wrong.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Launch Ember (`cargo run` or packaged binary).
2. Navigate to `...`.
3. Perform action `...`.

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Environment
- **OS**: (e.g., Windows 11 24H2 / macOS 15 / Ubuntu 24.04)
- **Ember Version / Commit**: (e.g., `v0.1.0` or commit SHA)
- **WebView Runtime**: (e.g., Edge WebView2 version / WebKitGTK version)

## Logs / Screenshots
If applicable, attach screenshots or relevant lines from your UI error log:
- Windows: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Ember\logs\ui_errors.log`
- Linux: `$XDG_DATA_HOME/Ember/logs/ui_errors.log`
- macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/Ember/logs/ui_errors.log`
